info.title: Varity AI Gateway API
info.description: Provider-neutral managed inference, served by the Varity AI Gateway at ai.varity.app. The text chat, streaming and tool-call surfaces are OpenAI-compatible. The image-edit and transcription routes take either the OpenAI SDK's multipart/form-data upload (file fields image or image[] and mask; file) or an application/json body with inline base64 parts (image.data, audio.data); both are validated as one contract. Tool execution and orchestration are client-managed.

row_reasons.e2ee_transport_unattested: The model speaks an end-to-end-encrypted or TEE-attested protocol this gateway does not attest; it is never sent plaintext.
row_reasons.no_neutral_operation: No public operation of this API serves the model (for example image upscaling).

unserved_types.video: Video generation is an asynchronous job API; this gateway does not serve it yet.
unserved_types.music: Music and sound-effect generation is an asynchronous job API; this gateway does not serve it yet.
unserved_types.decision: Decision models (for example jev-latest) have no operation in this API.

get.summary: List freshness-bounded models admitted by Varity
get.description: Anonymous public discovery: the full admitted catalog projected at the anonymized privacy floor. Account, credential and per-request privacy policy are enforced on the authenticated routes, so the response privacy_scope is always anonymized here.

privacy_scope.description: Effective privacy floor used to project this catalog.

post.summary: Create a finite text chat completion
post.description: Creates a streaming or non-streaming text response. Tool-call generation and transport supported on eligible models. Tool execution and orchestration are client-managed.

messages.content: Explain this API in one sentence.

200.description: Completion JSON, or SSE when stream is true

schema.description: OpenAI-compatible data frames ending in a usage-bearing chunk and data: [DONE]. Every chunk carries the same id (chatcmpl-{request_id}) and created as a non-streaming completion would.

post.summary: Create embeddings with an admitted embedding model
post.description: Returns one OpenAI-compatible embedding vector per input string. Only a model whose projected capabilities advertise output_modalities ["embedding"] is routable; a chat-only model is rejected.

post.summary: Generate images from a text prompt
post.description: Provider-neutral image generation on image-capable models. Results are returned inline as base64; Varity does not persist generated image bytes. The declared mime_type is the type of the returned bytes, and the returned image's size is the one encoded in those bytes: a model may quantize the requested size to one it supports, as the 2026-09-16 live flux-2-pro route did. Billing is the provider per-image price plus the managed rate.

size.description: Requested WIDTHxHEIGHT. The model may return a different pixel size; the authoritative size is the one encoded in the returned bytes. Defaults to 1024x1024.

value.prompt: A red cube on a table

200.description: Provider-neutral image result with inline base64 images

b64_json.description: Inline base64 image bytes; never persisted by Varity.

content_violation.description: The provider returned output that violates its content policy.

blurred.description: Safe mode returned a blurred image.

post.summary: Edit an image from a source image and prompt
post.description: Provider-neutral image editing on image-capable models. Send the OpenAI SDK multipart/form-data upload (one source image in image or image[], optional mask) or application/json with the source image as image.data (base64) and image.mime_type; both are validated as one contract. More than one source image is rejected (param $.image). A source image or mask above 25 MB is rejected.

image.description: The one source image; image[] with exactly one file is the same field.

200.description: Provider-neutral image result with inline base64 images

b64_json.description: Inline base64 image bytes; never persisted by Varity.

content_violation.description: The provider returned output that violates its content policy.

blurred.description: Safe mode returned a blurred image.

post.description: Send the OpenAI SDK multipart/form-data upload (file field file; the part type, else the filename extension, is the media type) or application/json with the audio as audio.data (base64) and audio.media_type; both are validated as one contract. The accepted media types, the 25 MB byte ceiling, and the 600-second audio-duration admission bound are the provider-neutral contract; the model id must advertise capabilities.transcription. Returns JSON (or plain text when response_format is text). Transcription is request/response with no streaming mode.

200.description: Transcription JSON, or text/plain when response_format is text

post.description: Returns audio bytes in the requested format (the model default when omitted), with the matching audio/* content type. The model id must advertise capabilities.speech, and the format must be one the model publishes in capabilities.speech_formats. Set stream true for a chunked binary response; there is no SSE framing.

200.description: Audio bytes in the requested format

get.summary: List recent owner-scoped inference request metadata
get.description: Returns metadata only for the authenticated owner and current key or workload attachment scope. Returns no prompt, response, provider identity, upstream cost, reservation, secret, or idempotency key. Request metadata is retained for 30 days, then deleted; money records outlive it in the billing ledger.
Returns authoritative customer spend from settled AI Gateway charges plus the separate prepaid Gateway balance. Provider identity and upstream cost never cross this interface.

get.summary: Get the authenticated tenant privacy policy
get.description: Returns the privacy floor enforced by the managed-inference admission authority. With a scoped API key the effective floor is reported beside the account floor, so a key can never be read as looser than it is.

Returns direct ledger aggregates without provider identity, upstream cost, prompt content, or response content. Percentiles remain null until the documented sample floor is reached, and source freshness is explicit.

post.summary: Signed Stripe webhook for Gateway balance funding
post.description: Authenticated by the Stripe-Signature header over the exact request bytes. Events for other Varity products are acknowledged and ignored. Funding is idempotent by Stripe object id.

VarityApiKey.description: An owner-bound Varity API key with an inference service scope. Provider credentials are never accepted.

RequestId.description: The request id: the caller's canonical UUID X-Request-Id when one was sent, otherwise one minted UUID. A chat completion's id is chatcmpl- followed by this value.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque tenant-scoped key. Send the same key when retrying: reuse is rejected with 409 duplicate_request rather than charging twice, and Varity persists only an owner-bound digest. Omit it and Varity issues a key per request, so each call is admitted and billed independently.

Deadline.name: X-Varity-Deadline-Ms
Deadline.description: Absolute Unix-epoch deadline in milliseconds. Omitted, past, or malformed values are replaced by the server maximum (120000 ms from receipt); a later value is capped to that maximum.

RequestLogCursor.name: cursor
RequestLogCursor.description: The last request_id from the previous page.

RequestId.name: request_id
RequestId.description: Exactly one request: the X-Request-Id its response carried. Returns at most one row.

RequestCreatedAfter.name: created_after
RequestCreatedAfter.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, fractional seconds optional: 2026-09-16T13:00:00Z or 2026-09-16T13:00:00.000Z. Offsets are rejected.

RequestCreatedBefore.name: created_before
RequestCreatedBefore.description: Same format as created_after; must be later than it.

ImageInput.description: Inline image bytes for an application/json body (bare base64). A multipart/form-data request sends the file itself instead.

dependency.description: Present on a 503 when a named verifier or dependency was unavailable.

diagnostic_code.description: Present when the code is a managed-inference failure cause: ai_gateway.<code>.

failure_domain.description: Who decided the failure: Varity, an inference supplier, or an unavailable Varity-operated dependency (named in `dependency`).

total_tokens.description: Authoritative total tokens; never less than prompt_tokens plus completion_tokens.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from a provider cache and included in prompt_tokens.

CustomerCharge.description: Versioned customer charge state. A request is charged exactly its provider cost, which may exceed the reserved maximum. A request that failed or was cancelled before provider effect is released without a charge; an interrupted request is charged only the usage observed before the interruption.

oneOf.description: The balance ledger is configured but could not be read for this response: balances are unknown, not zero.

cash_balance_usd.description: Negative when a request cost more than its reservation; new requests are refused until balance is added.

CustomerBilling.description: The prepaid AI Gateway balance. It is financially isolated from Varity Cloud billing and promotional value.

unit.description: per_million_tokens carries token rates; per_image a flat per-image request; per_million_characters (speech) and per_audio_second (transcription) carry their rate in input with output and cached_input at 0.

CustomerPrice.description: Current managed customer rates for the preferred qualified route, observed at the stated time and identified by an immutable price version. Rates are the actual provider cost with no markup; the Varity 5% service fee is charged when balance is added. They describe the current catalog observation, not a permanent guarantee; each admitted request snapshots its own route and price evidence before provider effect.

streamed.description: Null only for historical rows created before streaming attribution.

ttft_ms.description: Real time to first emitted content/tool token for streams; null for non-streaming or unobserved output.

duration_ms.description: Total Varity managed-inference duration across any safe fallback.

output_throughput_tokens_per_second.description: Streamed completion tokens per second after the first output token; null when TTFT is unavailable.

privacy_floor.description: The privacy floor the request required. legacy_unknown only for requests recorded before floors were enforced.

privacy_class.description: The privacy class of the route that served the request. Null when the request was never dispatched to a route, or was recorded before this field existed.

PercentileMetric.description: Percentiles are available only at 20 or more samples; insufficient_samples covers 1–19 samples and empty covers zero.

arguments.description: Untrusted JSON text supplied by the model.

CacheControl.description: Provider-native prompt-caching marker. Forwarded unchanged to a route that supports prompt caching and dropped for one that does not; cached prompt tokens bill at customer_pricing.cached_input.

ContentPart.description: One part of a multimodal user message. Images and documents are transient request input: Varity never stores their bytes, in any database, object store, cache, or log.

url.description: An http(s) URL the provider can fetch, or a data:image/<mime>;base64,... URL.

detail.description: OpenAI vision hint; accepted and ignored.

oneOf.description: A document the model reads. Routed only to models whose capabilities.input_modalities include `document`. The provider extracts it to text before the model sees it, and that text is billed as prompt tokens at the route's provider cost. Accepted: PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, plain text, Markdown, CSV, JSON and common source-code files. A data URL is limited to about 768 KB decoded (the 2 MB request body limit, base64-encoded); a public URL is fetched by the provider, up to 25 MB.

url.description: A public http(s) URL whose path ends in an accepted extension, or a data:<mime>;base64,... URL.

filename.description: Helps the model refer to the file; required to name the format of an application/octet-stream data URL.

cache_control.description: Accepted and not forwarded: the provider file part carries no cache marker.
Accepted for client compatibility and normalized away; only a content part marker is forwarded.

content.description: Plain text, or — for a user message — a typed parts array carrying images or documents.

Tool.description: A client-managed function definition. Varity transports eligible tool calls but does not execute or orchestrate the tool.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on generated tokens. Varity reserves against this bound before dispatch and forwards it as the upstream hard cap, so a response may stop with finish_reason "length" — including when the provider reported another reason for an answer that used the whole bound. Defaults to 2048 when neither this nor max_tokens is sent.

max_tokens.description: Accepted as an alias of max_completion_tokens for OpenAI compatibility. Sending both with different values is rejected.

response_format.description: Structured output. json_schema is honoured on models whose capabilities.structured_outputs is supported; text is the default.

stream_options.description: Accepted for OpenAI compatibility; it does not change the response. A stream always ends with a usage-bearing chunk: Varity always requests usage from the provider (openai-chat-wire.ts, venice.ts), and a stream the provider ends without usage accounting fails with stream_terminated rather than completing. include_usage false does not suppress it.

reasoning_effort.description: Portable reasoning control, honoured on models whose capabilities.reasoning_effort is supported. Omitting it means the model default.

privacy_floor.description: Per-request privacy floor. It may only tighten the account policy.

web_search.description: Ground the answer in a live web search. Honoured only by models whose published `capabilities.web_search` is true; the provider default is off.

x_search.description: Ground the answer in the provider's X (Twitter) search. Same rule as `web_search`.

web_scraping.description: Read the pages linked from the latest user message (up to 5 URLs) into the model context. Refused with 400 when no route of the model can read links. Billed at the provider cost of the request, which includes the provider fee per successfully read page; the provider default is off.

id.description: `chatcmpl-{request_id}`: the same request id as the X-Request-Id response header, the error envelope request_id and the request log. Every chunk of a stream carries this same id. The upstream provider's id is never returned.

created.description: Unix seconds when Varity received the request; one value for the body and every chunk of a stream.

citations.description: The sources a `varity_extensions.web_search` answer drew on, exactly as the provider reported them. Optional: present only when the provider reported at least one source, so a client must treat absence as "none reported". Carried on non-streaming responses; a streamed response does not carry it.

content.description: Excerpt of the source the provider used, when reported.

date.description: Source date as the provider reported it, when reported; not normalized.

CapabilityEvidence.description: Tri-state justification for one capability boolean. A boolean cannot say WHY it is false: `unsupported` is proven by a provider catalog or a failed route certification, while `unknown` is merely not measured. Only a proven `unsupported` withholds a capability; an `unknown` must never be rendered as unsupported.

source.description: Where the state was read. `unobserved` is the honest default when nothing has read it; it is never inferred from the boolean.

observed_at.description: When this state was last evaluated.

reason.description: Present only on `unsupported`/`unknown`, naming what withheld or blocked the capability. Free text so a producer can add a reason without a schema change.

CapabilityEvidenceMap.description: ADDITIVE and optional capability evidence. A producer that predates the map omits it entirely, so absence means "no evidence published", never `supported`. A capability name this gateway does not publish is dropped rather than rejected, so the map carries exactly these six keys.

id.description: Provider-neutral Varity model id. The seven curated ids are stable identities. Other opaque model-* ids may change until an alias, replacement, and deprecation registry is published.

key.description: Stable slug of who built the model, as the supplier reports it; `unreported` when no evidence was observed.

maker.description: Who built the model, never who serves it (owned_by is always varity). A supplier brand is never a maker.

capabilities.description: Production-verified Gateway Core capabilities for the current route contract, in the versioned projection the AI Gateway publishes. Tool calls mean generation and transport only; execution is client-managed. The binding fields (context_window, privacy, availability) are duplicated from the model top level so both public catalogs publish one shape; customer_pricing is published once, at the model top level. An EVIDENCED capability boolean (chat_completions, streaming/streaming_text, tool_calls, streaming_tool_calls, structured_outputs, json_schema) is present only for a proven state; an `unknown` omits it, and its `evidence` entry is the authority.

version.description: Capability shape version; bumped only on a breaking change.

input_modalities.description: Request input modalities every routable candidate accepts.

output_modalities.description: Response modalities this model can produce.

chat_completions.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

transcription.description: True when POST /v1/audio/transcriptions accepts this model. An audio model has chat_completions false.

speech.description: True when POST /v1/audio/speech accepts this model.

speech_formats.description: Output audio formats this speech model can produce. Empty unless speech is true.

streaming.description: Legacy alias of streaming_text, served so clients written against the pre-versioned four-boolean shape keep working. Always equal to streaming_text and present exactly when it is.

streaming_text.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

tool_calls.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

streaming_tool_calls.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

max_tools.description: The most tools one chat request may carry: the smallest bound known for any route of the model. A request above it is refused with 400 `too_many_tools` before any supplier call. Absent means no bound is known (none published, none measured), never unlimited.

structured_outputs.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

json_schema.description: Present only when proven. Absent means the state is `unknown`, never unsupported.

privacy.description: Strongest currently available route class, duplicated from the model top level.

privacy_routes.description: Provider-hidden route-level privacy classes, duplicated from the model top level.

privacy.description: Strongest currently available route class. Private means the provider contract supports the required retention and training posture; it is not confidential compute. Anonymized means Varity withholds direct Varity identity and raw key data, while the provider still processes the content under its disclosed handling terms.

privacy_routes.description: Provider-hidden route-level privacy classes currently available for this exact Varity model identity. Fallback is restricted to the requested privacy class or stronger and never silently downgrades privacy.

data.description: Base64 audio bytes. The decoded size is capped at 25 MB.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language hint; omitted lets the model auto-detect.

duration_seconds.description: Seconds of input audio as reported by the provider; the per-audio-second billing basis.

stream.description: When true the response is chunked binary audio rather than one complete file. Not SSE.
